rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Green-haired old river hag reaching out from River Tees; not the beautiful maiden alternate.

visual_requirements.description: Old hag with green hair, one head two eyes two arms, fully covered in opaque ragged cloth.
Reach aggressively toward the riverbank/viewer, associated with grabbing ankles and drowning victims; splashes are ordinary bodily displacement, no water command.
River Tees bank with foam on the black water.

aura: Menace from the green-haired hag c01/c02 lunging at the riverbank as the ankle-snatcher c06, no magical aura.
artistic_choices: No victim or injured child shown; the reaching action confronts the viewer.
Opaque ragged river-soaked dress is modest editorial clothing, not asserted iconography.
Low waterline closeup and moonlight preserve human scale; no gigantic body or invented fins/fangs.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Peg Powler, the green-haired river hag of the English River Tees who seizes ankles at the bank.
ANATOMY: ONE old hag with a deeply weathered, gaunt elderly woman's face, one head two natural eyes two human arms, long soaked GREEN hair hanging in heavy strands, wearing a completely opaque ragged brown dress covering torso and shoulders. No fins, no gills, no horns, no tusks, no extra teeth. Lower body remains submerged. [peg-powler-c01, peg-powler-c02]
MOMENT: LUNGE out of the black river toward the viewer at the bank, near hand sweeping toward our ankles below the frame, mouth open with a vicious desperate snarl, narrowed eyes locked on us, green hair streaming forward from the movement. The other hand grips a root at the bank. Make the face and near hand overwhelmingly dominant.
POWER: she grabs people by the ankles and drags them underwater; show only the predatory reaching action, nobody injured and no child shown. Ordinary dirty water and foam splash from her moving body, no control over waves. [peg-powler-c01, peg-powler-c06]
SCALE & CAMERA: extremely close waterline low angle, strong foreshortened hand, face and hair filling frame, human size maintained through nearby roots and reeds.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one cold crescent-moon reflection casts hard wet highlights on face and fingers, deep walnut shadows, wet river spray and ordinary low mist.
SURFACE: wrinkled wet skin, matted green hair, coarse saturated opaque fabric, muddy roots, white river foam.
SETTING: eroded muddy edge of the River Tees with dark flowing water and local floating foam, reeds in deep shadow. [peg-powler-c01, peg-powler-c03]
MOOD: unmistakably predatory hag emerging suddenly, dangerous and imposing, never beautiful maiden, ordinary woman swimming, cute or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; exactly five fingers on each visible hand, no extra heads or limbs; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
